comment: QUESTS.md E7, ALD-2 The Vigil. Sir Hamo's first page is the published reaction shot; the second look with Aldric is the vigil. Not yet; then the vigil broken (Aldric falls), lost (everybody falls) and kept to dawn, fought for real with the party on auto-battle: troop 53, dawn at the end of turn five, Aldric drawing nearly every hit. The shield, Aldric's alone. Afterwards for everybody: Sir Hamo and the chapel.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._blushes = $gameVariables.value(7); window._stories = $gameVariables.value(15); window._lines = []; window._troops = []; window._hits = []; window._vigil = false; window._appeared = []; window._turns = -1; }; window._mark(); window._pick = undefined; const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { return sc.call(this, c, window._pick === undefined ? d : window._pick, k); }; window._auto = false; const ab = Game_BattlerBase.prototype.isAutoBattle; Game_BattlerBase.prototype.isAutoBattle = function () { return (window._auto && this.isActor()) || ab.call(this); }; const ap = Game_Action.prototype.apply; Game_Action.prototype.apply = function (t) { if (this.subject().isEnemy() && t.isActor()) window._hits.push(t.actorId()); return ap.call(this, t); }; const pv = BattleManager.processVictory; BattleManager.processVictory = function () { window._turns = $gameTroop.turnCount(); window._appeared = $gameTroop.members().filter(e => e.isAppeared()).map(e => e.enemyId()); return pv.call(this); }; window._mode = ''; const ss = Scene_Battle.prototype.start; Scene_Battle.prototype.start = function () { ss.call(this); this._bf = 0; window._troops.push($gameTroop._troopId); }; const su = Scene_Battle.prototype.update; Scene_Battle.prototype.update = function () { su.call(this); this._bf++; const al = $gameActors.actor(6); if (al.isStateAffected(41)) window._vigil = true; if (window._mode === 'keepup' && al.isAlive()) al.setHp(al.mhp); if (window._mode === 'fall' && this._bf === 300) { al.addState(1); al.setHp(0); } if (window._mode === 'lose' && this._bf === 300) { $gameParty.members().forEach(a => { a.addState(1); a.setHp(0); }); } }
